schemaInput.title: Aggregate Designer
schemaInput.description: Design DDD aggregate structures visually from your database schema. Paste a TableSchema or AggregateConfig JSON to get started.
schemaInput.featureVisualDesc: Drag-and-drop table nodes to design aggregate boundaries interactively.
schemaInput.featureRelationDesc: Connect entities with OneToMany, ManyToOne relations and auto-detect FK columns.
schemaInput.featureExportDesc: Export AggregateConfig JSON ready for the code generator pipeline.
schemaInput.footer: Spring JPA Kraft — Aggregate Config Builder

toolbar.title: Aggregate Designer
toolbar.packageTooltip: Java/Kotlin base package for generated code (e.g. com.example.order)
toolbar.idStrategyTooltip: Default ID generation strategy applied to all entities unless overridden
toolbar.hiddenColumnsDesc: These columns will be hidden from all table nodes.
toolbar.hiddenColumnsPlaceholder: Type column name and press Enter
toolbar.hiddenColumnsTooltip: Configure columns to hide from all tables
toolbar.helpDragNode: Drag node into boundary — Assign to aggregate
toolbar.addTableTooltip: Add a new table to the canvas
toolbar.defaultColumnsDesc: These columns are automatically appended after the <id> column when creating a new table.
toolbar.removeIndexFirst: Remove default index referencing this column first
toolbar.defaultIndexesDesc: These indexes are automatically added when creating a new table.
toolbar.enumsDesc: Define enum types that can be assigned to columns. Values will be used as-is for Kotlin enum constants.
toolbar.enumValuesPlaceholder: Type a value and press Enter

configPanel.selectHint: Select a node or edge to configure
configPanel.tipNode: Click a table node to set it as Aggregate Root or configure its ID strategy.
configPanel.tipEdge: Click an edge to configure the relation type and FK mapping.
configPanel.aggregateRootTooltip: Mark this entity as the root of an aggregate. Root entities own the lifecycle of their child entities.
configPanel.isRoot: This entity is an aggregate root
configPanel.belongsToAggregateTooltip: Assign this entity to an aggregate. It will appear within the root's boundary.
configPanel.idStrategyTooltip: Override the global ID generation strategy for this entity. 'Inherit' uses the global setting.
configPanel.cardinalityTooltip: Set how many records each side can have in this relationship.
configPanel.foreignKeyTooltip: The foreign key column that links these two tables.
configPanel.edgeRoutingTooltip: Choose which side of each table the edge connects to.

addTable.title: Add Table
addTable.defaultColumnHint: A default id BIGINT PK AUTO_INCREMENT column will be created.
addTable.invalidFormat: Table name must start with a letter and contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and underscores.

tableEditor.title: Edit Table
tableEditor.deleteConfirmDesc: This will remove the table and all its connections.
tableEditor.allColumnsMustHaveName: All columns must have a name.
tableEditor.onlyOneAutoIncrement: Only one column can be AUTO_INCREMENT per table.
tableEditor.auditColumnLocked: Audit columns are managed by the system.

connectionModal.title: Create Relation
connectionModal.newColumnNotice: A new column {{column}} BIGINT NOT NULL and index will be added to {{table}}.
connectionModal.manyToManyWarning: Many-to-Many is not supported. Use a join table with two Many-to-One relations instead.

validation.title: Validation
validation.noPrimaryKey: Table "{{table}}" has no primary key column.
validation.joinColumnNotExist: Join column "{{column}}" does not exist in table "{{table}}".
validation.noIndexOnFk: FK column "{{column}}" in "{{table}}" has no index.
